チェキ（撮影写真）の保存解像度を Size で指定した値に変更します。false:
Changes the save resolution of cheki (photos) to the value set in Size. When false, the game default (320x320) is used.
- Compatibility: a 320x320 version is always saved to the game's own save, so your main save won't be corrupted even if you remove the MOD. The high-res version is stored in a MOD-specific sidecar file (main save + .exmod).
- Location: `BepInEx/data/net.noeleve.BunnyGarden2FixMod/` (not covered by Steam Cloud Save). Copy this folder manually when moving to another PC.
- Slot support: high-res data is managed separately per save slot.
- Side effects: higher resolution increases memory and save size (at 1024: about 48MB / 12 photos).

Encoding runs only once, at shutter time. Loading auto-detects the format by magic bytes.

距離保存で衣装を体型に追従させた際の補正量 (disp) を、衣装メッシュ上で近:

More iterations smooth out surface jitter (high-frequency noise from inverse-distance² sampling), but
too many dull the clothing's detail (folds, cup ridges). 0 disables smoothing (raw distance-preserve result).
The blend rate toward the neighbor average per iteration of distance-preserve smoothing. 0.0 disables smoothing, 1.0 is maximum.
Raise it if jitter remains; lower it if clothing detail gets dull.
